# MD Sumon Arefin

> MD Sumon Arefin is an Administration & Operations Professional based in Savar, Dhaka, Bangladesh, with 7+ years of experience in restaurant management, e-commerce operations, inventory management, and team coordination.

MD Sumon Arefin holds a Diploma in Computer Engineering from Daffodil Polytechnic Institute and has worked across administration, operations, e-commerce, and customer-facing roles in Bangladesh and Cambodia. Core skills include office administration, workflow optimisation, team coordination, data entry, ERP software, inventory management, Shopify & WordPress, and e-commerce management.
